site_name: IBM/Kyndryl Boulder data center campus, 6300 Diagonal Highway, Boulder, CO 80301

phases.label: 115,000 sq ft expansion (retrofitted office building), IBM opened it June 17; page byline dated July 24, 2008

lead.notes: I opened the Data Center Knowledge page (byline July 24, 2008). It says IBM officially opened the expansion of its Boulder data center on June 17, and that the data center is now IBM's largest at more than 300,000 sq ft, which implies earlier data center space. No page I opened gives the year the first data center building began operating. Search snippets say IBM broke ground on the Boulder site in 1965, but that is a plant, not necessarily a data center. The page does not give the street address, so the tie to 6300 Diagonal Hwy is inference. Current operating status was not confirmed by a page I opened.

site_name: DataBank ATL4 (South Fulton), 200 Selig Dr SW, Atlanta, GA 30336

lead.year_evidence_quote: All three data centers were constructed and leased almost entirely to hyperscale cloud and emerging hyperscale providers.
lead.notes: DataBank's Sept. 24, 2025 release (opened) says ATL4, IAD3 and LGA3 'were constructed and leased', which supports built but not an opening year. The December 2023 financing release said ATL4 was 'expected to open in Q3 2024', which is forward-looking, and the two pages are about 21 months apart, too wide to bracket. DataBank's site page still says 'future site of ATL4', and Brasfield & Gorrie's page (copyright 2026) says it is 'currently building' the 352,200 sq ft facility, so status is not fully clear. Operating status is inferred from the 2025 release.

site_name: Microsoft Douglasville datacenter campus, 1601 N River Rd, Douglasville, GA 30122

lead.notes: Microsoft's Georgia fact sheet, published October 2025 (opened and read as text), says 'We currently are building new datacenters in Douglasville, Palmetto, and East Point', which is campus-level and does not say whether any Douglasville building is running. The Greater Atlanta page has the same wording and no dates. The AJC (August 2026) gives no operating status. I did not set not_yet_operating because the wording is ambiguous for a multi-building campus and the permit exists. Directory sites claim a 2024-2025 first building, which is not evidence.
